statements.statement: PLOS ONE issued an Expression of Concern about this article.
Fig. 7 does not correspond to its legend or the Results text, and does not report data for an LSD1 siRNA experiment.
The stored paper reports that LSD1 siRNA reduced migration in H460 cells.
The notice also notes a possible discontinuity in the Fig. 4 LSD1 panel.
The notice notes too little control detail to replicate the transfection experiments.
Similarities with other groups' work call into question the validity and provenance of the reported results, and the authors did not respond.
The draft's Section 3 cites [12] for the H460 scratch-assay result that LSD1 siRNA reduced migration.
The draft's Section 3 treats the H460 knockdown result as the clearest indication that LSD1 drives migration.
The notice says Fig. 7 does not report data for an LSD1 siRNA experiment, so the result statement is not supported.
The draft's Background section cites [12] for higher LSD1 in lung cancer tissue than in normal lung in 80 patients.
The notice says similarities with other groups' work call into question the validity and provenance of the reported results.
The notice names no specific problem with the tissue data.
PLOS ONE issued an Expression of Concern about this article.
